resources.string:
Nika is a screen reader for Android.

New in this version:
• New section "Artificial intelligence": the Nika AI agent and macros.
• Macros: your own sets of steps (press a button, pause, say, type, open an app, system buttons). Record buttons by focus, then assign the macro to any gesture or key.
• The separate Gemini items are replaced by macros.
• Macros can hold a button and release it after moving the finger up, down, left or right by 0-40 mm (for example, Telegram voice messages).
Write to the developer in Telegram: report a problem or suggest an idea
